leadText: Mew and the Wave-Guiding Hero: Lucario Music Collection is the original Japanese soundtrack CD of the 8th Pokémon movie, Lucario and the Mystery of Mew. It was released in Japan on August 3, 2005.
plainText:
Mew and the Wave-Guiding Hero: Lucario Music Collection is the original Japanese soundtrack CD of the 8th Pokémon movie, Lucario and the Mystery of Mew. It was released in Japan on August 3, 2005.

 }

==Trivia==
This soundtrack was released exactly one year after the release of the previous movie soundtrack, for Destiny Deoxys.
